requirement R1 A function component's output is rendered, and the component receives its element's props
requirement R2 Components nest, stand side by side and can be the root of the tree
requirement R3 `props.children` carries the elements, text and components written inside a component
requirement R4 A component of the same type at the same position keeps its nodes and takes new props, text and handlers
requirement R5 Another component, or a plain element, at a position replaces the component's nodes in place
requirement R6 A component that disappears takes its nodes out of the page, and only those
requirement R7 A component mounted in one render can be removed or replaced by the very next render, with or without a render in between
requirement R8 Keys work on components as they do on elements: inserted, removed and reordered components keep their nodes and typed values
requirement R9 A component is a unit of work of its own: it adds one to the unit count and has no node
requirement E2E Whole sessions with components

end
